repos.description: Welcome to the CSS Art Museum – an open-source initiative where creativity meets code! 💫  This project is a digital gallery dedicated to showcasing artworks created with HTML, CSS and Javascript. The idea is simple: every contributor adds their own CSS creation, and together we build a growing museum of styles, colors, and imagination.
